**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

You will be accountable for marketing’s contribution to pipeline for your region. You carry specific pipeline goals and delivering them is your priority. If it doesn't contribute directly to pipeline, we don't do it.

You will be the marketing partner that regional GTM teams turn to first. Working with sales leaders to develop the regional marketing plan, you will turn global programs into campaigns that are highly relevant to your accounts and show how Teradata can solve their problems. Your work accelerates the sales cycle, generates new pipeline from existing customers and new logos, and strengthens customer preference for Teradata’s solutions.

**What You'll Bring**

You own the outcome, not the activity. You judge your work by pipeline created, and treat event attendance, click rates, and even MQLs as signals, not the goal. When pipeline is behind plan, you flag it early, bring options, and change course.

You are a partner to sales, not an order taker. You start with the customer’s problem, not the product, and you choose the activity that makes selling easier over the one that only fills the calendar.

You ask why we do things the way we do, and you don’t settle for “that’s how it’s always been”. You challenge colleagues, from sales leaders to marketing teammates to your own manager, when you see a better way. You do it constructively and always focused on the outcome, and you welcome being challenged back. You try something different when the usual play stops working, share what you learned, and stop what isn’t working, even when it was your idea.

What you say will happen, happens: on time, with the follow-up planned and nobody chasing you. You give colleagues honest feedback and make the people around you better.

**Not for you if:** you measure success by events run or campaigns launched, you wait for a brief rather than help shape the plan, or you would rather perfect a plan than get it into market. It’s also not for you if follow-up, attribution, and reporting feel like someone else’s job.

* Travel domestically and internationally to bring your programs to life in market, and stay close to the sales teams you support

Let the data decide

* Own reporting on full-funnel performance, pipeline, conversion, and ROI by program, account, and segment
* Move budget and effort toward what works and away from what doesn't, managing the regional calendar and budget

**Who You'll Work With**

* Day to day: regional sales leaders, account teams, and SDRs, staying close on pipeline and follow-up through regular conversations
* Regularly: your field marketing leader, EMEA field marketing colleagues and the global demand generation and field marketing team

* At least 5 years in B2B marketing (field marketing, demand generation, or ABM), ideally in enterprise software, data, analytics, or AI

Someone who understands how Gen Z and Millennials consume culture, fashion, and content, but who also lives in the numbers. Job Title: Marketing Manager Reports to: Managing Director and Creative Director Department: Marketing Location: East London / Hybrid Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Job Summary: This is a pivotal leadership role within a small but ambitious fashion brand. With our Head of Marketing, E-commerce & Merchandising moving on and a newly appointed E-commerce Manager joining the team, we are restructuring to create clearer ownership across marketing and trading. The Marketing Manager will own brand marketing strategy end-to-end from campaign ideation through to performance analysis ensuring our storytelling connects emotionally with our audience while delivering measurable sales growth. You will lead our Social Media Marketing Executive, manage budgets, oversee paid performance channels, build community, and work in close partnership with the E-commerce Manager to drive conversion, retention, and revenue. Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Marketing Strategy & Leadership Develop and own the annual and quarterly marketing strategy aligned to brand objectives and revenue targets. Build and manage the 360° marketing calendar (product drops, campaigns, activations, wholesale moments, key trading periods). Translate creative direction into commercially successful campaigns. Set clear KPIs across all channels (traffic, conversion, ROAS, CAC, LTV, retention, engagement). Own the marketing budget, allocating spend effectively across paid, content, partnerships and activations. Forecast marketing spend and return in collaboration with the Managing Director and E-commerce Manager. Lead weekly marketing performance meetings and present monthly reports to senior leadership.
* Campaign Development & Brand Storytelling Lead end-to-end campaign creation from concept development to execution and post-campaign analysis. Work closely with the Creative Director to ensure campaigns feel culturally relevant, distinctive and on-brand. Create big ideas that resonate with both Gen Z and Millennial audiences. Oversee shoot planning: mood boards, casting direction, content formats, channel outputs, timelines and budgets. Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, ahead of product launches, and with clear conversion objectives. Develop innovative launch strategies that create hype, urgency and community participation. Ensure campaigns extend beyond social integrating email, paid ads, partnerships, PR hooks and site merchandising.
* Performance Marketing & Paid Media Own paid media strategy across Meta, Google, Pinterest and emerging platforms. Manage agency or freelancer relationships where applicable. Set ROAS and CAC targets and continuously optimise performance. Work closely with the E-commerce Manager to align paid traffic with on-site conversion strategy. Test new customer acquisition channels and scaling opportunities. Lead retargeting and customer re-engagement strategies. Analyse attribution models and adjust spend accordingly.
* E-commerce & Trading Collaboration Partner closely with the E-commerce Manager to: Align marketing campaigns with stock levels and trading priorities. Identify hero products and drive focus accordingly. Improve conversion rate through aligned messaging and landing pages. Build strategies to increase AOV and repeat purchase rate. Contribute to weekly trading meetings with data-led insights. Ensure marketing supports sales targets during peak periods and slower trade moments. Develop retention strategies including email, SMS and loyalty initiatives.
* Social Media & Community Building Line manage the Social Media Marketing Executive. Set content strategy and oversee execution across Instagram, TikTok and emerging platforms. Ensure content balances brand storytelling with conversion-driven messaging. Build a strong, engaged community — not just followers. Drive UGC strategy and community amplification. Identify and manage influencer and brand partnerships aligned with our aesthetic and audience. Monitor cultural trends and platform changes to keep the brand relevant.
* Email & CRM Strategy Collaborate with E-commerce Manager on CRM strategy including segmentation, automation flows and lifecycle marketing. Oversee weekly email planning and approve all campaign communications. Improve open rates, click-through rates and revenue contribution from email. Collaborate with E-commerce Manager to refine customer journey touchpoints.
* Analytics & Reporting Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports across: Paid media Organic social Email Website performance Campaign ROI Translate data into clear, actionable insights. Identify growth opportunities and areas for optimisation. Own testing roadmap across channels (creative testing, landing page testing, messaging).
* Budget Ownership & Resource Management Set and manage the annual marketing budget. Allocate spend strategically across brand and performance activity. Negotiate contracts with freelancers, agencies and partners. Ensure strong ROI across all marketing investments.

Success in This Role Looks Like Campaigns launch on time and feel culturally relevant. Paid media hits or exceeds ROAS targets. Clear growth in revenue and conversion rate. Increased customer retention and community engagement. A structured, forward-planned marketing calendar. A motivated, high-performing marketing team.

**12 month FTC**

**Location - London (hybrid)**

**Salary - up to £45,288**

**Our offer to you**

We pride ourselves in being a great place to work, providing a supportive culture with opportunities to grow and develop your career, achieve a healthy work life balance and to be recognised for the great work you do. You will receive:

* Competitive salary and pension scheme
* 33 days holiday (inclusive of bank holidays) - increasing to 38 days over 5 years

* Discounts – you will have access to Blue Light and NHS Discounts as well as discounts on mobile phones, gym membership, cinema tickets, restaurants, holidays and shopping

**About Us**

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team of over 1,100 employees and over 20,000 volunteers, united by our goal of saving lives through essential first aid services, training and campaigning. As a charity with rich heritage and a long history of serving humanity, we are proud of our past and excited about creating a healthier, safer, more resilient future.

St John Ambulance works at the heart of communities, supporting and enabling them to access and receive physical and mental health first aid. We do this through developing and providing effective community response and outreach services (e.g. Ambulance response) and using our longstanding expertise to empower people with vital clinical skills and the confidence to use them (e.g. our Volunteers and Community Advocates, and Young Responders programmes).

Are you an experienced graphic designer ready to take the next step in your creative career? We’re looking for a talented and strategically minded Content Manager (Graphic Design) to help bring the St John brand to life through engaging, impactful and inspiring visual content. Building on your graphic design expertise, you’ll broaden your creative remit to lead the planning, development and delivery of content across print, digital, film and photography, helping us tell our story and connect with the people and communities we serve.

You’ll combine creative flair with excellent project management skills, developing content yourself while commissioning and managing external creative partners to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget. Working collaboratively with colleagues across St John, you’ll shape creative briefs, manage competing demands, champion our brand and oversee our digital asset library, ensuring content is accessible, consistent and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real difference, using your creative expertise to support our mission and bring our HEART values to life.

**About You**

· An experienced graphic designer with formal training in design, art or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience, and a strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to create compelling visual content for both print and digital channels.

· A confident and creative communicator, able to develop ideas, write engaging copy and clear creative briefs, provide constructive feedback and bring people with you through your ideas and expertise.

· Highly organised and an effective project manager, experienced in commissioning and managing creative content, coordinating external agencies and freelancers, managing budgets and balancing competing priorities to deliver great results.

· Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop, with experience of Premiere and ideally After Effects. Photography and video skills would also be an advantage.

· Collaborative and confident building relationships with people at all levels, able to influence and inspire colleagues, work on your own initiative and use insight, data and feedback to make informed creative decisions.

· Passionate about delivering work that makes a difference and committed to inclusive, compassionate leadership. You understand the importance of safeguarding, GDPR and brand consistency, and are motivated by St John’s HEART values of Humanity, Excellence, Accountability, Responsiveness and Teamwork. You’re also willing to travel nationally to connect with colleagues and our frontline teams.

**About the Role**

· Lead the planning, commissioning and delivery of creative content across a wide range of channels, including print, digital, film and photography, ensuring projects support organisational priorities and integrated campaigns.

· Bring creative ideas to life through hands-on graphic design, producing high-quality visual assets while also briefing and managing freelancers, agencies and other suppliers to deliver projects on time, to budget and to brand standards.

· Manage and develop our digital asset library, Brandfolder, ensuring content is well organised, accessible and effectively managed, with all permissions, safeguarding and GDPR requirements rigorously followed.

· Champion the St John brand, maintaining and promoting brand guidelines and supporting colleagues, volunteers and partners to create confident, consistent and on-brand communications through advice, guidance and workshops.

· Work collaboratively with teams and stakeholders across St John to understand content needs, prioritise competing demands, manage resources and budgets, and use project management tools and performance insights to inform decisions.

· Support and develop the creative content and brand team, including line managing 1–2 direct reports, providing creative project management support and role-modelling compassionate, inclusive and values-led leadership.

##### **Marketing****On-site****Farringdon, London**

  

### **About Housekeep**

Housekeep is on a mission to build the UK's best home services business.

Since starting in 2014 with £5,000 and one cleaner, we've grown into a one-stop shop for home cleaning and tradespeople. We've delivered more than two million home cleans with a 4.9-star rating, and expanded to seven more UK cities this year alone.

That growth has made us one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. The Financial Times has recognised us four times: three years running in the FT1000, and now as one of Europe's Long-Term Growth Champions for our growth over the past decade.

Now we're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to help keep us one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for the next decade too.

### **The opportunity**

We're looking for a curious, commercially minded Growth Marketing Manager to help us acquire more customers, improve conversion and accelerate growth.

This is a broad, hands-on role spanning digital acquisition, experimentation, conversion optimisation and customer retention.

* **Use data to make decisions:** Analyse performance, identify opportunities and measure the impact of your work.
* **Work across teams:** Collaborate with marketing, product, engineering and operations to deliver improvements.
* **Own results:** Set clear objectives, manage projects and take accountability for commercial outcomes.

### **What we're looking for**

**Essential**

* Strong, well-rounded experience in digital marketing, spanning acquisition, conversion and retention.
* A proven track record of delivering measurable growth across different marketing activities.
* Experience designing, executing and evaluating marketing experiments.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting performance data.
* Commercial understanding of conversion, acquisition costs, customer value and profitability.
* A hands-on, proactive approach, comfortable moving between strategy and execution.
* Resourcefulness and the ability to deliver results without relying on large budgets, teams or expensive tools.
* Curiosity, creativity and a willingness to challenge assumptions.

* Experience working closely with product or engineering teams.

* Growth in customer bookings.
* Improvements in conversion and acquisition efficiency.
* Incremental revenue and customer value generated.
* Volume and commercial impact of experiments.
* Successful development of new growth opportunities.

### **Why join Housekeep?**

You'll join a small, ambitious team where your ideas can become reality quickly. You'll report directly to the Head of Marketing and work with the wider executive team.

You'll have access to meaningful customer data, the opportunity to work across the full marketing funnel and real ownership of projects from concept to delivery.

We value curiosity, commercial thinking and results over big budgets or complicated processes. If you enjoy finding opportunities, testing ideas and making things happen, this is a role where you can make a significant impact.

We're an office-based team in Farringdon.
